morning: Every map projection is a confession — here is where I chose to lie, here is what I sacrificed for legibility.
afternoon: The Prime Meridian was arbitrary until it wasn't. Greenwich won not because it was correct but because the British Navy was large.
evening: Fort Lauderdale weather: unknown. Even the instruments fail sometimes. The map has blank spots.

night: A meridian is a scar the mind leaves on the earth. The earth doesn't feel it. The mind can't navigate without it.
